notes.title: Pandamonia v0.2h released! (Date:2019-03-12)
notes.content:
Hi everybody,

Pandamonia v0.2h released! Here are the updates below:

1.Level 21 unlocked.
2.Two new enemy characters created, all evil Elf.

You will find out that I'm not a very good game character modeler, especially the female characters, after all I'm just another poor programmer. However, I'll try my best always. Enjoy yourselves, my friends.

Sincerely,
Hoffman Chang

notes.title: Pandamonia v0.2g released! (Date:2019-03-04)
notes.content:
Hi there,

Version 0.2g of Pandamonia released! Here are the Updates & Bug Fixes below:
1. One bug fixed - some game levels will stuck in the very beginning while pressing down 'Skip All' button.
2. Internal Graphic Settings changed.

There's not much time left for me to build up the rest of the game levels(21-30). So I have to hurry up. Thank you for your supports and patience!

Yours,
Hoffman Chang

notes.title: Pandamonia Version 0.2a released! (Date:2019-01-23)
notes.content:
Hi there,

Version 0.2a has been released! Here are the updates below:

Yours,

notes.title: New Updates today (Date: 2019-01-11)
notes.content:
Hi there, you can now add your own customized battle music into the game folder now. Here are the steps below:

1.Right click on Pandamonia in the game library, choose Properties.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34145235/c5e1f8f38a23d4a9f56c426f9cd354ad52d3de28.png[/img]
2.LOCAL FILES ----> BROWSE LOCAL FILES...
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34145235/c2f32af5ff26cdbbb3bb8d5082e343583e61b3b0.png[/img]
3.In the game root folder, choose PC_Data
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34145235/95cf7a27582c63fd99885f4becae7d4e97f326dd.png[/img]
4.Choose Music folder
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34145235/c149b1463cdfe927c35f4d7fb1f2a310cdee9129.png[/img]
5.Inside the Music folder, for example, if you wanna replace the battle music of Day 3, then copy and paste an mp3 format file into this folder, rename it "day3fight.mp3". Then launch your game, the BGM should have been replaced.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34145235/391625bf7823eee02ea20b22a258b9703e511277.png[/img]

FILENAME FORMAT : dayxfight.mp3 (x means day level in game)

Thank you all the same...

Yours,
Hoffman Chang

tags.feature: Hi there, you can now add your own customized battle music into the game folder now.
